messages:
emma: Heads-up — deploy-bot blocked staging promote for payments-service chart bump. preflight hook failed with pod validation error.

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for payments-service v1.4.3 -> v1.5.0
Hook: preflight/postupgrade hook failed
Logs:
```
Error: Pod "payments-init" is invalid: spec.containers[1].imagePullPolicy: Unsupported value: "Always"
```

kai: Wait, imagePullPolicy 'Always' is valid in k8s — do we have an admission webhook rejecting 'Always'?

tony-sre: There's a secpolicy admission webhook that enforces registry restrictions; it started rejecting sidecars pulling from dockerhub due to recent policy change. It returns 403 in the hook.

matt-p: I saw this in staging earlier — we changed the sidecar image source and also bumped chart default values to pullPolicy: 'Always' in values.yaml.

anita: Release notes need to call this out. If we pin chart back we should add a note about registry and sidecar changes.

emma: Options: 1) revert chart to v1.4.2 for immediate unblock (pin), 2) hotfix values to set sidecar.pullPolicy: IfNotPresent, 3) ask infra to temporarily relax webhook for canary. What's the least risky?

matt-p: I can cut v1.5.0-hotfix with values override to IfNotPresent and push canary to staging. ETA 20m. I'll also include a canary-only values override so we don't touch prod.

anita: I'll update release notes with the rollback context and a remediation checklist.

deploy-bot: Manual canary command invoked by matt-p: `/deploy promote payments-service --chart=v1.5.0-hotfix --values=canary-pullpolicy-override.yaml`

emma: OK — plan: matt will create hotfix chart and promote to staging canary; if green for 30m we'll decide to rollforward or pin for prod. If fails, we'll pin to v1.4.2 and schedule prod window next Tue. tagging @oncall and @release-managers

kai: ack :thumbsup: I'll monitor webhook logs and see if infra can whitelist the canary namespace temporarily.

tony-sre: I'll leave webhook logs open and post back with any denied requests.

emma: thanks all — assign follow-ups: matt (hotfix), anita (release notes), kai/tony (webhook monitoring).
